bands.title: Frugal AI Enablement That Works in Production, Not Just Demos
Most Enterprises Have AI Pilots -Almost None Have AI in Production

items.title: Pilots that never reach production
items.body: The gap between ‘AI proof-of-concept’ and ‘AI that runs in daily operations’ is where billions of enterprise investment disappear. Models that work brilliantly in a Jupyter notebook never make it to the hands of the business. The problem isn’t the AI – it’s the adoption gap. Ignitho’s applied AI practice is built specifically to close that gap. We deploy AI within your existing workflows, integrate it into the tools your teams already use, and build explainability in from the first sprint – so adoption is a feature, not an afterthought

items.title: Black-box models nobody trusts
items.body: AI outputs that a business user can’t interrogate or challenge. When a model fires a risk flag or rejects an application, someone needs to be able to ask why and get an answer they can act on

items.title: From pilot to production in one sprint cycle
Governed and compliant from day one
Built on what you already own

bands.title: From Messy Data to Production AI - in Sprints

items.title: 7-Day AI Triage & Use Case Qualification
items.body: Map your current AI estate, identify where automation and intelligence create the highest ROI, and qualify the data readiness of each candidate use case. We clear the messy data objection on day one – starting where you are, not where you’d like to be

items.title: Data Readiness & AI Foundation Architecture
items.body: Build the data foundation the AI requires – feature engineering, data cleaning and tagging, and model architecture design. Define governance, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls before the first model trains

items.title: Iterative Build & Deployment 7 to 30-Day Sprints
items.body: Train, evaluate, and deploy in short cycles. Every sprint closes with a live model a business user can interact with – not a notebook or demo. Explainability and audit trail built in

items.title: MLOps, Monitoring & Continuous Improvement
items.body: Implement pipelines to monitor drift, retrain models, and maintain audit trails. The model improves continuously while your team stays in control

bands.title: Specialist PODs - self-contained, outcome-driven, Day-1 productive
bands.lead: Ignitho deploys self-contained Specialist PODs: cross-functional delivery units that combine Human Intelligence (senior practitioners), Artificial Intelligence (automation and AI agents), and Technology Intelligence (your existing platforms). Each POD integrates into your existing Agile/Jira workflow on Day 1. There is no ramp-up theatre, no management overhead, and no hand-holding required. Your engineers get time back, not a new team to manage

items.title: Single point of accountability
items.body: One POD Leader owns delivery and acts as your primary interface. No diffuse responsibility, no finger-pointing between teams

items.title: Agile velocity: 7 to 30-day sprint cycles
items.body: Short, continuous delivery cycles with visible progress at every sprint review. Business stakeholders see outcomes, not activity metrics

items.title: Plug-and-play integration
items.body: Works within your existing tools, governance frameworks, and operating models. No disruptive change management. No rip-and-replace mentality

items.title: AI-augmented delivery speed
items.body: Automated data quality validation, AI-assisted code review, and accelerator libraries built into the POD reduce delivery time by up to 40%
